title: feat(web): auto-switch users with no org in this region to their org's region

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge The redirect target is a fixed region origin plus the current route, proven safe by the org-region helpers and by `loadOnboarding`'s key guard; only the leaving branch lacks a test. 1 note · tests partial −1 · risk medium Adds `isLeaving` to the wrong-region screen so a user with no org in this region is sent to the same page on their org's dashboard instead of the notice. The gate logic is sound; the new branch has no test of its own. - `leaveTargetOf` returns the target-region URL only when no membership is served here - `init` issues `LeaveForRegion`, a full-page `load`, when that URL exists - `wrongRegionView` renders `bootSplash` while the page leaves ### Before merge - [ ] **Manual** · Check the auto-leave on the live US and EU dashboards: `VITE_MAPLE_REGION_APP_URLS` is prd-only, so no preview can exercise it ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · New init branch that leaves the region is untested; only the helper is tests · [`apps/web/src/page/onboarding/wrong-region.scene.test.ts:62-68`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/9eb0900a29fcd65082982b0ff181546819384ec7/apps/web/src/page/onboarding/wrong-region.scene.test.ts#L62-L68) The added test calls `leaveTargetOf` directly, so nothing asserts the behaviour the PR actually adds: `init` returning the `LeaveForRegion` command with `https://app.eu.maple.dev/traces` (index.ts:184) and `wrongRegionView` rendering the boot splash for `isLeaving` (view.ts:205). This file already pins `step.commands` for the other branch (line 50), so a wrong target URL or a splash rendered with no command would ship uncaught. Mock `../../lib/region`'s `regionAppUrl` (`VITE_MAPLE_REGION_APP_URLS` is empty in tests, so the real one always returns `undefined`) and assert `step.commands` plus that the "Switch organization" button is gone for `memberships: [organization]`. ``` Add a second case to this file that goes through `init(route, "WrongRegion:/traces", { ...inputs, memberships: [organization] })` with `regionAppUrl` mocked to `https://app.eu.maple.dev`, and assert the returned command's `args.url` and that the scene renders the splash instead of the heading. ```
What was checked - Self-redirect loop ruled out: `wrongRegionOf` implies `homeRegion` is not the current region (`organizationServedIn` tests `regions.includes`) - Target host is always a region URL, never user input: `regionAppUrls` comes from `VITE_MAPLE_REGION_APP_URLS`, prd only (`packages/infra/src/cloudflare/stage.ts:225`) - `load` fires once per key: `loadOnboarding` keeps the model while `key` holds (`update.ts:466`)
`9eb0900` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
